notes.title: "The Leopard Catgirl in Miaoli" will release in october 20th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8336155/c1c2be57b04ef5b9902d765f47e401fafb0d0dc6.png[/img]

[url=The Leopard Catgirl in Miaoli]https://reurl.cc/e5314M[/url]

[b]Story[/b]
In the year 201X, Hualian county held a mockery of a referendum to become the Kingdom of Hualian. After the Kingdom of Hualian is established, it had a domino effect where all 22 counties in Taiwan held a similar referendum. Surprisingly, all of them were successful, leading to chaos in Taiwan.

The protagonist Wang Cheng-En was a pharmacist who worked in Taipei. When he was barred from working there, he returned to his hometown Miaoli Empire. Along the way, he didn't expect to come across a wounded leopard catgirl Pisuka Riya. By taking care of her, a story on the romance between the two of them in Miaoli Empire begins.

[b]Game Features[/b]
1.Stander virtual novel play style.2.With saving and loading feature.
3.Support three different languages.
4.Contain many original musics and songs.

[previewyoutube=-C-ySUiSDLc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: DLC-Radio Drama
notes.content:
[h1]在你下載前請注意:這是一個中文廣播劇檔案，沒有任何字幕，你的電腦必須能夠播放一般的WAV檔。(部分捏他)[/h1]
[h1]Please note before you download: This is a Chinese radio drama, no any subtitles, your computer must be able to play WAV files.[/h1]

如果你猶豫了，你可以在[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/361060?beta=0]商店頁面[/url]試聽一下。
If you hesitate, you can listen in [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/361060?beta=0]here[/url].

這個檔案並不是透過遊戲開始的，那如何找到該檔案？
在你下載後，請到 收藏庫 中，右鍵"The Rainy Port Keelung"找到最下面的內容>本機檔案...>瀏覽本機檔案，您就會看到該DLC的資料夾，點進去後便可以看到此3首WAV檔。

This file is not through the game,and how to find the file?
After you download, please go to the library, Click on the right button of your mouse on "The Rainy Port Keelung", find the bottom of the Properties> LOCAL FILE> BROWE LOCAL FILE.., you will see the DLC folders and double left click it, you can see the 3 WAV files, finally enjoy it.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/aXf1VI7.png[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Tn8ftTA.png[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/9aWIe35.png[/img]

notes.title: The Rainy Port Keelung Update
notes.content:
[h1] 此更新可能會有極少部分玩家檔案遺失，在此深感抱歉。	[/h1]
[h1] We are very sorry for those handful of players may be missing files in this update.[/h1]

更新：部分無法正常運作的bug

如下載後無法執行的玩家請刪除後重安裝試試看

卡片已經在處理中，預計明天處理好。
成就系統一樣在處理中，會儘快完成。

Steam Trading Cards and achievements have already in the process.

[b]English subtitles are still being processed,we hope to complete as soon as possible.[/b]
